items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: he says, well, come on down, and I'm recording these guys here, and so I got in on that record session.

ctx.x: Well, yes. I'll tell you what I did. When I first got out, I came to Kansas City, and I was lucky enough to run into Dave Dexter, and he was going this thing with Capitol Records. And I think Julia was on there, and I backed her on a couple of tunes, Julia Lee, Tommy Douglas, Oliver Todd, and Baby Lovett and those guys.

And I happened to run into him that day. And so he says, well, come on down, and I'm recording these guys here, and so I got in on that record session. And he asked me what I was going to do, and I told him, -- I probably go back and try to put the band back together again. And so actually, what I did, I got a job back in New York and I went back there to
organize the band. And then -- oh, I had different people writing, you know what I mean. And --
